content: {"reasoning":"The claim remains denied for missing required authorization after records submission and a medical-necessity appeal; this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. The codes and billing order are valid, so no supported correction or additional rework would resolve the denial. CO-197 assigns the denied balance to contractual/provider responsibility, not patient responsibility, and the deductible does not justify transferring that balance to the patient; with no secondary payer or remaining supported recovery path, it is uncollectible.","action":"write_off"}
